name: Kretam Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年公司没有宣布新的业务扩张、出售或新业务线，主要动态是持续披露种植板块的月度及季度产量数据。种植板块FFB产量在2026年第二季度同比下降16.67%，第三季度同比基本持平；CPO产量第二季度同比下降9.01%，第三季度同比上升4.91%。公司宣派2026财年第一次中期股息每股1仙。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any new business expansion, divestment or new business line. The main developments were continued disclosure of monthly and quarterly production figures for the plantation segment. FFB production in Q2 2026 fell 16.67% year-on-year and was broadly flat in Q3 2026, while CPO production fell 9.01% year-on-year in Q2 2026 and rose 4.91% year-on-year in Q3 2026. The company declared a first interim dividend of 1 sen per share for FY2026.

segments.name: 种植与棕油厂
segments.note: 今年持续披露月度及季度产量，FFB和CPO产量在第二季度同比下降，第三季度CPO产量同比回升。
segments.note_en: The segment continued to disclose monthly and quarterly production figures; FFB and CPO production declined year-on-year in Q2 and CPO production recovered year-on-year in Q3.

segments.note_en: The group declared a first interim dividend of 1 sen per share for FY2026 and tabled ordinary resolutions to shareholders.

actions.title: KRETAM - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣派2026财年第一次中期股息每股1仙，除权日为2026年7月7日，派发日为2026年7月30日。
actions.text_en: Declared a first interim dividend of 1 sen per ordinary share for FY2026, with ex-date 7 July 2026 and payment date 30 July 2026.

actions.title: 1. Proposed Renewal Of Shareholders' Mandate And Proposed New Shareholders' Mandate For Recurrent Related Party Transactions Of A Revenue Or
actions.text: 提呈股东普通决议案，包括更新股东授权进行经常性关联交易，以及更新公司回购最多4%已发行股份的授权。
actions.text_en: Tabled ordinary resolutions to shareholders, including renewal of the shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions and renewal of authority to purchase up to 4% of the company's issued shares.
